event_station_013@node_spine_3.quirk: Their outline is perfectly clear except in your peripheral vision, where it declines to commit.

shipLog.text: ◆ Station approach. Life support here is maintained by the lowest bidder. MARV has met the lowest bidder. He would like to be undocked by evening.
◆ Crop planted. MARV notes this is the point of no return. The mission now depends on something that needs water and doesn't respond to reason.
Arrived: No Refunds. The leg cost −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, +2 MORALE, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
Departure Protocol. The captain chose “Check the crop one last time before departure”. Noted.
The crop is fine. +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. It will not last.
Arrived: HD 40307g. The leg cost +4 MORALE, −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
◆ The tomatoes are fine. The tomatoes are always either fine or in crisis. There is no middle state. (+2 morale)
Cabin Fever. The captain chose “Let them sort it out themselves”. Noted.
You let it run. −15 FOOD, −6 MORALE, 1 DAY. As calculated.
◆ Planetary approach. MARV has reviewed the atmosphere. It is breathable for things that are not us. Most atmospheres are.
Arrived: Haven Station (Prices Not Haven-Like). The leg cost −3 FUEL, −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, +2 MORALE, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
The Half-Built Relay. The captain chose “Give them the time”. Noted.
Your ship holds the girder steady while their welders walk the seam. +8 FUEL, +4 MORALE, 4 DAYS. It will not last.
